verbatim.scope: Within each frozen exported component, group retained only; keep highest clipscore then smallest record ID; move others to deleted. Pending and old deleted unchanged. Singletons unchanged.
verbatim.strict_alternative: Count deletions by exact original string equality separately.
invariants: Normalized retained caption set unchanged in every component
Every added deletion has a surviving same-normalized-caption witness

benchmark.inputs: FLAG_REP_RUN benchmark_exports.jsonl flag_rep_cov=b_cov and flag_rep=b; COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN clipscore, public_records.text
benchmark.A1: All multi-record components per partition; 200 clusters/953 records and size-five 160 clusters/800 records separately; before/after states and normalized/strict deletion counts.
benchmark.A2: Frozen dual-AI strict=both lost, loose=either lost; preserve old deletion audit and add zero caption-information loss for same-normalized-caption witnesses. Keep-one lost-source fates retained/held/vb_deleted/old_deleted, all and size-five. Paper number before/after table.
benchmark.expectation: Exact fractions strict*n/deleted and loose*n/deleted; also unrounded floating-point values; not enacted random export.

downstream.B1: Verify FLAG_REP_RUN retained IDs against both parquets and component against CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN. Apply vb globally before fixed subsets. Controls remove exactly 35208-len(b_fr_cov_vb). No reporting provenance enters method.
downstream.composition: FLAG_REP_RUN composition plus distinct correct captions and redundant correct captions. Correct means not caption_swapped; distinct key=(original_image_id, strict_release_qc.normalize_text(text)), matching historical writing diagnostic; redundant=correct retained rows minus unique correct keys. Also report raw-string redundancy.

B2.retraining_control: FLAG_REP_RUN b_fr_cov, subset seed 20261104, all seven differences; stop abs(CIDEr difference)>.02
B2.settings: Reuse CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN train/generate/evaluator function bodies unchanged, 4370 steps per subset, same final checkpoint, same 5000-image test and 25010 references; same clean parquet and frozen subsets.

inherited_r70_training.reuse: CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN no_dedup,keep_one,semdedup,clean,b,b_cov,clipscore,random:80 existing train/evaluation receipts, no retraining except named gate.
inherited_r70_training.environment: CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN caption-env, GPT2/CLIP assets, annotations and evaluation code; FLAG_REP_RUN owns all outputs/cache paths.
inherited_r70_training.settings: Identical CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN ClipCap initialization, batch, optimizer, schedule, decoding and test membership. Background process durable progress; resume exact checkpoint/stream state and completed runs.

B2.reuse: CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN all8 methods and FLAG_REP_RUN all4 methods read-only; no new baseline training except prescribed control.
B2.resume: Original model/optimizer/scheduler/data/RNG checkpoints and partial generation; completion markers required.

B3.tests: Paired t two-sided/greater/less, alpha=.05, independent BY per family; CHAIR oriented lower better. P/N/S same CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN/FLAG_REP_RUN; no extra performance pass line.
B3.reports: Means/sample SD, raw and oriented average differences, better subsets, all raw and adjusted p.
B3.regression: All CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN/FLAG_REP_RUN/VERBATIM_EXPORT_RUN training sets with swapped fraction <.05: mean CIDEr vs distinct correct captions, slope/r/residuals. Separate frozen seven-set fit (FLAG_REP_RUN b_fr,b_fr_cov,clipscore_fr; CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN b,b_cov,clipscore,clean) predicts VERBATIM_EXPORT_RUN new sets; reporting only.

runtime.policy: Before/after each run extrapolate observed train+eval mean over all41; stop if measured or projected total >14h; do not reduce subsets.
